value.rationale: The smallest nontrivial connected one-cycle class exhibits a concrete Fourier-recovery transition: n=4 invertible, n=5 zero modes at one edge, n=6 first zeros only at four-edge signings with a two-shape graph-theoretic characterization, n=7 invertible again. The complete six-vertex rank 31568 and sharp minimum endpoint projection norm 9077/512 quantify information loss and stable recovery beyond the ordinary enumerative count and beyond first-band covariance. The signed-cycle forest formula permits independent exact verification of every coefficient and makes the shape boundary inspectable. This is a natural complete finite spectral invariant with explicit objects and a genuine interpretation as a cancellation order threshold, rather than an arbitrary coordinate slice.
risks: Finite benchmark and parity corollary do not settle general n; full classification in larger dimensions may have different structure.
